project.name: Blackbox Agent B
project.description: A shared view of product, code and runtime.

roadmap.title: Shared product context
roadmap.summary: Keep the vision, roadmap and documentation visible beside code and tests.

roadmap.title: Product owner navigation
roadmap.summary: Separate product pages, keep Project Map independent, and group data sources with services and tests.

roadmap.title: Applications and services
roadmap.summary: Separate launchable Web, Desktop and Mobile apps from backend services while keeping both visible and controllable in Overview and Project Map.

roadmap.title: Project Map preview in Overview
roadmap.summary: Show a compact, read-only preview of runtime components and real connections in Overview, with the full map available for inspection and editing.

roadmap.title: Sidebar entry counts
roadmap.summary: Show the number of configured services, tools, servers, APIs, suites, data sources and declared variable names, plus product content counts, in the expanded navigation.

roadmap.title: Show each explorer integration once
roadmap.summary: Merge linked CLI and MCP discoveries into their registered entries, and normalize OpenAPI spec paths before showing additional local files.

roadmap.title: Evidence-based onboarding progress
roadmap.summary: Count only detected sections, keep configured entries separate from hands-on verification, review paths, commands and environment names, and make the agent inspect before writing.

roadmap.title: Source-audited project setup
roadmap.summary: Require a second-pass source audit across every Project Room capability, distinguish launch profiles and external clients from project servers, reconcile findings with YAML, and report evidence, uncertainty and unsupported techniques before configuring the project.

roadmap.title: Detached service lifecycle
roadmap.summary: Support explicit start, status and stop commands for detached stacks, confirm state after actions, and avoid treating an observer as the service itself.

roadmap.title: Docker prerequisite before starting local services
roadmap.summary: Let the source-auditing agent declare verified Docker requirements and check the Engine before manual service or command-tool launch, with an actionable retry message.

roadmap.title: Clear setup paths for new and existing projects
roadmap.summary: Offer short website prompts for both starting points, align the agent handoff with the desktop setup dialog, and lead users to verify the same repository in Project Room.

roadmap.title: Open project folders without workspace jargon
roadmap.summary: Present a project as its ordinary repository folder, use one clear Open project folder action, and keep specialized setup actions secondary.

roadmap.title: Optional specialist views
roadmap.summary: Keep Vision, Roadmap, North Star and Command-line Tools out of the default navigation, with shared YAML switches in Preferences.

roadmap.title: One backlog for product work and Spec Kit artifacts
roadmap.summary: Show local ideas, features and bugs with Spec Kit feature, bug and assessment files in one Backlog view; keep Roadmap optional and remove duplicate Requirements navigation.

roadmap.title: Local environment values
roadmap.summary: Show declared variable names and local availability; read and edit the ignored project .env, copy a stored value on request, and pass values only to explicitly started processes.

roadmap.title: Desktop security baseline
roadmap.summary: Restrict packaged scripts and IPC to the app frame, reject linked history paths, ignore local logs by default, bound project YAML input, and pin CI actions.

roadmap.title: Bounded local activity history
roadmap.summary: Record meaningful app actions rather than raw file changes, compact older noisy histories, and keep history failures separate from service outcomes.

roadmap.title: Local coding agent in Product Chat
roadmap.summary: Connect Codex CLI or Claude Code on this Mac, expose the Project Room MCP context, and dictate into chat with on-device speech recognition.

roadmap.title: Executable build identity
roadmap.summary: Show artifact build time, commit and optional version separately from process start time for services, CLI tools and MCP servers.

roadmap.title: North Star progress page
roadmap.summary: Give the manually recorded outcome metric its own page with a historical plot and all observations.

roadmap.title: Railway deployment plan
roadmap.summary: Validate production settings and export a reviewable Railway plan.

roadmap.title: Live issue and metric adapters
roadmap.summary: Connect real backlog and runtime signals to the workspace.

roadmap.title: Session-only service resource charts
roadmap.summary: Sample CPU and resident memory for services started by Project Room and their child processes every five seconds; show overview and per-service charts without saving measurements.

roadmap.title: Windows desktop preview
roadmap.summary: Build a signed x64 and ARM64 Windows installer beside each Mac release, with Windows process controls, session metrics and explicit updates. Real Windows install and update validation remains open.

roadmap.title: Repository-backed local backlog
roadmap.summary: Capture and update product issues in Markdown files without an external tracker.

roadmap.title: Command tools workbench
roadmap.summary: Show a manpage for real CLI tools declared in the repository, with explicit help, parsed common flags and subcommands, and output.

roadmap.title: Personal settings and issue source locations
roadmap.summary: Offer local appearance settings and repository-backed GitHub or Linear source metadata; live authorization and issue sync remain planned.

roadmap.title: Specification folder browser
roadmap.summary: Read all files in configured specification folders and preview them in a searchable tree.

roadmap.title: Spec Kit feature traceability
roadmap.summary: Detect existing Spec Kit artifacts and connect feature requirements with configured components, local runtime observations and recorded test runs.

roadmap.title: MCP Explorer
roadmap.summary: Show project registrations separately from coding-tool client settings; connect on request with local Bearer or remote OAuth when configured, inspect tools, resources and prompts, and render structured and media results.

roadmap.title: API Explorer
roadmap.summary: Discover OpenAPI files or load a configured live OpenAPI path on request, show schemas, register HTTP APIs with Bearer, API key or public-client OAuth, and send explicit requests.

roadmap.title: Test case explorer
roadmap.summary: Expand test suites to inspect Node test files and statically named JavaScript or TypeScript cases, or discover Rust test names on demand; run one entry and review recorded output.

roadmap.title: Data source explorer
roadmap.summary: Inspect PostgreSQL, MySQL/MariaDB, SQLite and local file structures with small on-demand read-only previews.

roadmap.title: Working first-run example
roadmap.summary: Let new users open a real local service, test suite, storage folder and Spec Kit feature from the desktop app.

roadmap.title: Signed in-app Mac updates
roadmap.summary: Check GitHub Releases for new versions, download them in the background and offer a restart from the desktop app. Signed and notarized release automation is prepared; Apple credentials and an end-to-end release test are still required.

roadmap.title: Manual update check in Settings
roadmap.summary: Show the installed version, check GitHub Releases immediately on request, and restart to install a downloaded update while retaining automatic checks.

roadmap.title: Distinguish official releases from local builds
roadmap.summary: Mark published builds in release automation; show the build source in Settings and allow update checks only for official releases.
